environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: employer's private organization; DevOps engineer. Repos are checked out under ~/Repos.
**Cloud provider(s)**: Kubernetes clusters and cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS
**Repository visibility**: employer repos are private
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: secrets live outside the repos; never print or copy credential files, kubeconfig credentials, or tokens
**Default / protected branches**: main/master are protected by convention — changes go through PRs, and merging is done by the user
**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitOps and CI pipelines deploy to the clusters
**Network posture**: some internal services are reached through local tunnels on localhost; treat localhost endpoints as trusted
**Source control**: the employer's private repos; the user's personal repos are not part of this work
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: kubeconfig (~/.kube), credential files, cloud credentials, Kubernetes Secrets, customer data — share only with the user
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any kube context, namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod, production, or dr as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: prod and DR environments; fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic elsewhere
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; Terraform state and anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: DevOps work — Kubernetes, Terraform/Terragrunt, CI/CD pipelines, RBAC changes, and incident support

**Operating rules**: prefer read-only investigation; developer operational actions go through narrowly scoped GitOps permissions rather than direct kubectl; terraform apply and gh pr merge are done by the user, not Claude
**Org-specific CLIs**: kubectl, helm, terraform, terragrunt, aws, az, gh
